title: Toxin Binding
body:
Syntax: toxin binding <weapon>

Description: Permanently binds poison to one carried or wielded weapon. A poisoned hit can inflict Poisoned. Disenchant the weapon before binding a different property. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 30. Costs 45 Chakra and 15 Stamina; 8 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
